# FG-REPO-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`namespace-redirects`](../../ops/runbooks/namespace-redirects.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_move_that_keeps_losing_conflicts_is_namespace_move_contended` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ほかの変更と重なったため、移動または名前の変更を完了できませんでした。少し待ってから再度お試しください。
- en: The move or rename collided with other changes and could not finish. Wait a moment and try again.
- id: Pemindahan atau penggantian nama bertabrakan dengan perubahan lain dan tidak dapat diselesaikan. Tunggu sebentar lalu coba lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A namespace move, rename or tombstone release through the API (forge_hosting::Hosting::move_project, move_group, rename_user, release_tombstone; step D5 MR5) lost a retryable conflict on every attempt: its transaction was rolled back with FG-DB-0002 `retryable=true` (`deadlock` — two moves whose subtrees and targets cross each other; `subtree_unstable` — namespaces kept being created below the moving subtree while it was being locked; `tombstone_changed` — the tombstone's target was purged meanwhile; `serialization`) and was run again from the start, decided again each time, up to 3 attempts in all (forge_hosting::MOVE_ATTEMPTS). Nothing was written by any attempt. Not a bug by itself: it means heavy concurrent changes on the same part of the namespace tree.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `command` (project_move, group_move, user_rename, tombstone_release), `attempts` and `last_reason` (the FG-DB-0002 reason of the last conflict); the source is that FG-DB-0002. Look for other moves, creates or purges in the same subtree at that time (forge.audit_log by occurred_at: project.moved, group.moved, user.renamed, project.created, group.created, project.purged) and in pg_locks / pg_stat_activity for long transactions.

## 対処 (fix)

Retry the request (the client may retry it as is: nothing was written). If it keeps failing, find the competing writer (a script moving many namespaces at once, a purge of the subtree) and let it finish first; move large groups in parts.
